reference.title: Editing and Refactoring Commands
reference.shortdesc: Commands for restructuring content, inserting images and tables, and applying multi-file edits.

section.title: Rename Symbol (F2)
section.p: Place the cursor on an id attribute value, or a single key name inside a keys="..." attribute, and press F2 to rename it and update every href, conref, keyref, and conkeyref reference across the workspace. See for details on how conkeyref matches are verified before rewriting.

section.title: Move or Rename a File
section.p: Drag a .dita, .ditamap, or .bookmap file to a new location in the Explorer, or press F2 on the file itself, and confirm the prompt to update every inbound reference. See .

section.title: DITA: Extract Topic from Section
section.p: Place the cursor inside a <section> in the active topic to extract it into a new standalone topic file, replacing the original section with an <xref>. See .

section.title: DITA: Inline Conref
section.p: Place the cursor on an element carrying conref or conkeyref to resolve and splice the referenced content in place, removing the reference attribute. See .

section.title: DITA: Insert Image
section.p: Browse for an image file and insert a correctly structured <image> (optionally wrapped in <fig>) at the cursor. See .

section.title: DITA: Insert Table
section.p: Prompts for table type, column/row counts, and an optional header row, then inserts a <simpletable> or CALS <table> skeleton at the cursor. See .

section.title: DITA: Find and Replace in Files
section.p: Searches across the DITA files in your workspace and applies replacements through VS Code's native multi-file Refactor Preview. See .

section.title: DITA: Batch Update Metadata
section.p: Multi-select files in the DITA Explorer to set or clear a profiling attribute on all of them at once, validated against your subject scheme first. See .

section.title: DITA: Edit DITAVAL Conditions
section.p: Opens the Visual DITAVAL Condition Editor for the selected .ditaval file. See .
